Private equity rounds Seed through Series F sum to ~$1.95B (TechCrunch: ~$2B raised pre-IPO); Series F at $35B post-money. IPO'd on NYSE (PATH) April 2021 (~$1.34B offering, part secondary) — IPO excluded from total. Acquired fellow Seedcamp company Re:infer in 2022.
